title: Existing shafts.
officialText:
Elevator cabs installed in existing shafts shall be permitted to be smaller than that required by this
chapter where necessary to fit in the existing shaft, unless a larger cab size is otherwise mandated pursuant to Section 1101.3.
SECTION BC 3002
HOISTWAY ENCLOSURES
